Name: Reese Hitch Extender for 2" Trailer Hitches - 18" Long RP11004
Natural: Extend your trailer hitch receiver opening so that you can clear your spare tire when using your hitch-mounted bike rack or so that your trailer won't hit a rear-mounted propane tank when you make sharp turns. Powder coated steel resists rust.
